q:
Cloze Test (1/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 1.

'The global economy is currently (1)______ a period of unprecedented uncertainty. The (2)______ of new trade barriers has hindered international cooperation. While some nations have (3)______ to protectionist measures, others are trying to (4)______ new alliances. Experts warn that unless structural reforms are (5)______, the recovery will remain sluggish.'
e: Blank 1: 'Undergoing' (गुज़रना) किसी प्रक्रिया या कठिन समय से गुज़रने के लिए सबसे सटीक क्रिया है।

q:
Cloze Test (2/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 2.

'The global economy is currently (1)______ a period of unprecedented uncertainty. The (2)______ of new trade barriers has hindered international cooperation. While some nations have (3)______ to protectionist measures, others are trying to (4)______ new alliances. Experts warn that unless structural reforms are (5)______, the recovery will remain sluggish.'
e: Blank 2: 'Imposition' (लागू करना/थोपना) का प्रयोग बाधाओं (barriers) या करों के संदर्भ में किया जाता है।

q:
Cloze Test (3/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 3.

'The global economy is currently (1)______ a period of unprecedented uncertainty. The (2)______ of new trade barriers has hindered international cooperation. While some nations have (3)______ to protectionist measures, others are trying to (4)______ new alliances. Experts warn that unless structural reforms are (5)______, the recovery will remain sluggish.'
e: Blank 3: 'Resorted to' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूरी में किसी विकल्प को चुनना (to turn to something as a last resort)।

q:
Cloze Test (4/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 4.

'The global economy is currently (1)______ a period of unprecedented uncertainty. The (2)______ of new trade barriers has hindered international cooperation. While some nations have (3)______ to protectionist measures, others are trying to (4)______ new alliances. Experts warn that unless structural reforms are (5)______, the recovery will remain sluggish.'
e: Blank 4: 'Forge new alliances' (नए गठबंधन बनाना) एक standard collocation है जिसका अर्थ है कड़ी मेहनत से संबंध बनाना।

q:
Cloze Test (5/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 5.

'The global economy is currently (1)______ a period of unprecedented uncertainty. The (2)______ of new trade barriers has hindered international cooperation. While some nations have (3)______ to protectionist measures, others are trying to (4)______ new alliances. Experts warn that unless structural reforms are (5)______, the recovery will remain sluggish.'
e: Blank 5: 'Implemented' (कार्यान्वित करना) सुधारों (reforms) को लागू करने के लिए सही शब्द है।

q: Error Spotting: Scarcely had (A) / the function started (B) / than the power (C) / supply failed (D).
e: Rule of Correlative Conjunctions: 'Scarcely/Hardly' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

q: Error Spotting: Not only the (A) / principal but (B) / also the teachers (C) / was present (D).
e: Subject-Verb Agreement: 'Not only... but also' में verb हमेशा पास वाले subject (teachers - Plural) के अनुसार आती है। 'Was' की जगह 'Were' होगा।

q: Error Spotting: If I would (A) / have known (B) / your arrival, I (C) / would have met you (D).
e: Conditional Sentence Type 3: 'If' वाले clause में 'had + V3' लगता है। सही: 'If I had known...'

q: Error Spotting: Neither of (A) / the five (B) / applicants is (C) / suitable for the post (D).
e: Rule: 'Neither' का प्रयोग केवल दो के लिए होता है। दो से अधिक (पाँच) के लिए 'None' का प्रयोग होगा।

q: Error Spotting: He is (A) / enough wise (B) / to understand (C) / your tricks (D).
e: Adverb Rule: 'Enough' जब Adjective को qualify करता है, तो उसके बाद आता है। सही: 'wise enough'।

q: Sentence Improvement: She is *the most unique* singer I have ever heard.
e: Grammar Rule: 'Unique', 'Ideal', 'Complete' जैसे शब्द अपने आप में पूर्ण होते हैं, इनके साथ Comparative या Superlative degree नहीं लगती।

q: Sentence Improvement: Being a rainy day, *I could not go* out.
o: It being a rainy day, I
As it was a rainy day, I
e: Dangling Participle: 'Being' का अपना subject 'It' होना चाहिए, अन्यथा 'I' ही बारिश वाला दिन बन जाएगा।

q: Sentence Improvement: He *did not and could not* understand the gravity of the situation.
o: did not understand and could not
did not and could not understood
did not understand and could not understand
e: Parallelism: 'Did not' और 'Could not' दोनों के बाद V1 आनी चाहिए। यहाँ 'understand' को common नहीं लिया जा सकता क्योंकि auxiliary verbs अलग हैं।

q: Sentence Improvement: I *prefer tea than* coffee.
e: Rule: 'Prefer' और 'Preferable' के साथ 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

q: Synonym of 'EPHEMERAL':
e: 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ है क्षणिक या बहुत कम समय रहने वाला (Transient/Short-lived)।

q: Synonym of 'ABHOR':
e: 'Abhor' का अर्थ है घृणा करना (Hate/Detest)।

q: Antonym of 'LOQUACIOUS':
e: 'Loquacious' (बातूनी) का उल्टा 'Reticent' या 'Taciturn' (कम बोलने वाला) होता है।

q: Antonym of 'ZENITH':
e: 'Zenith' (शीर्ष बिंदु) का उल्टा 'Nadir' (सबसे निचला बिंदु) होता है।

q: One-word Substitution: A person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain.
e: 'Stoic' (वैरागी/उदासीन) वह व्यक्ति है जिसे सुख-दुख से कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता।

q: One-word Substitution: One who speaks for others.
e: दूसरों की ओर से बोलने वाले को 'Spokesman' (प्रवक्ता) कहा जाता है।

q: Idiom: 'To spill the beans' means:
e: इसका अर्थ है किसी गुप्त जानकारी को उजागर कर देना।

q: Idiom: 'To read between the lines' means:
e: छिपे हुए अर्थ या भावनाओं को समझने को 'Read between the lines' कहते हैं।

q: Active/Passive: The news surprised us.
o: We were surprised by the news
We were surprised at the news
We were surprised with the news
e: Prepositional Passive: 'Surprise', 'Astonish', 'Amaze' के साथ 'at' का प्रयोग होता है, 'by' का नहीं।

q: Active/Passive: It is time to take tea.
o: It is time for tea to be taken
It is time that tea is taken
Tea should be taken on time
e: Structure: 'It is time + for + object + to be + V3' सही passive form है।

q: Active/Passive: They said that the earth is round.
o: It is said that the earth is round
It was said that the earth is round
The earth is said to be round
e: Complex Sentence Passive: दोनों ही रूप (It is said... और The earth is said to be...) व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हैं।

q: Direct/Indirect: He said, 'Bravo! You have done well.'
o: He applauded him saying that he had done well
He exclaimed with joy he did well
He told him bravo he did well
e: Exclamatory (Applaud): 'Bravo' वाले वाक्यों में 'Applauded + object + saying that' का प्रयोग होता है।

q: Direct/Indirect: She said to me, 'Don't go there.'
o: She told me not to go there
She forbade me to go there
e: Imperative Negative: 'Forbade' के साथ 'not' नहीं आता, जबकि 'told/asked' के साथ 'not to' आता है।

q: Direct/Indirect: He said to his servant, 'Go away at once.'
o: He ordered his servant to go away at once
e: Sense: मालिक और नौकर के बीच 'Ordered' या 'Commanded' का प्रयोग सही है।

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: as well as Q: physical health R: mental health S: is important
e: सही क्रम: 'Mental health as well as physical health is important' (RPQS)।

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: to solve Q: it is R: the problem S: impossible
e: सही क्रम: 'It is impossible to solve the problem' (QSPR)।

q: Synonym of 'METICULOUS':
e: 'Meticulous' का अर्थ है बहुत सावधानी और विस्तार से काम करना।

q: Antonym of 'OSTENTATIOUS':
e: 'Ostentatious' (दिखावटी) का उल्टा 'Modest' (शालीन/साधारण) होता है।

q: Select correctly spelt word:
e: सही स्पेलिंग 'Separate' है।

q: Select correctly spelt word:
e: सही स्पेलिंग 'Lieutenant' है।

q: Error Spotting: The scissors (A) / which are (B) / on the table (C) / is mine (D).
e: Rule: 'Scissors', 'Trousers', 'Spectacles' हमेशा plural verb लेते हैं। 'Is' की जगह 'Are' होगा।
